ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: No allocator exhaustion, integer-overflow proof, fsync or concurrent save guarantee. Environment EN_AGR/EN_PX/EN_BEAM can change semantics; tests use explicit beam1 where available. Preflight discovered empty-trained PTagger panics on nonempty tagging; model/explain use nonempty synthetic training and preserve that gap.
obernants.domain: Bounded synthetic sentences and same-build serializable types; parallel arrays aligned, graph symbols valid, valid tree indices, finite table scores and bounded counters. Tests exercise2 synthetic one-token training sentences only for model/explain, never corpus/held-out/API/GPU.
obernants.observation_scope: Heads use root0 and1-based word coordinates; Graph truncates heads to u16, while parser/UD use usize. Ud children returns0-based child indices. GNode lemma references global dictionary or local graph heap; Store fingerprint binds global IDs but not arbitrary target serde schema. annotate repairs tree whereas kbest/complete/explain/Model.encode do not; treating them as identical is invalid. Expert consumes conllu Sentence, not Graph directly; callers must preserve tags/features/relations when adapting. Construct callbacks must return enough dependent entries and valid renderable heads.
obernants.operator: Compatible composition cannot equate completion/kbest with repair-aware annotate, cannot accept changed envelope checksum, cannot bind one sentence word to two expert variables, cannot label equality with a rounded construction floor red. Invalid public coordinates and empty-trained taggers are outside admitted runtime contract.
